blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Law enforcers dismantled an active drug den and arrested three individuals, including a senior citizen, during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Tangke, Talisay City, on Thursday afternoon, November 5, 2026. Operatives from the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Regional Office 7 (PDEA-7) and the Philippine National Police Regional Intelligence Unit 7 (PNP-RIU-7) raided the facility at around 2:30 p.m. in Sitio Rattan, following a two-month case buildup initiated by tips from concerned residents. PDEA-7 Regional Director Joel B. Plaza identified the alleged drug den maintainer as alias “Rex,” 55, a construction helper residing in the barangay. READ: 3 […]...
